title: the bundle check reads the embedder's measured files by their hash
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's local runs; CI was not run by the card.

findings.claim: in a models folder, the embedder's measured record grants a pass only to binary content of no known kind; its weights file is still listed as not terminology by its extension and its text files are read, not hashed; hashing every listed file would refuse the stand-in weights of test_a_models_folder_lists_weights_and_reads_the_rest, a changed assertion that needs the integrator's ruling

make_bundle.sh with a real models folder holding the embedder's real tokenizer file was not run: the file was not fetched, so the pass of a real site bundle's vocabulary check is shown on synthetic bytes only
